page.title: Email Templates
page.description: Reusable email content skeletons; reference via template_id when sending, {{sample}} placeholders render per variable (HTML variables are escaped automatically).
page.emptyDescription: Create a template, then reference it in the send API with template_id + variables to keep body content in one place.

form.name: Template name
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectRequired: Please enter a template subject (may include {{sample}} placeholders)
form.htmlBodyHint: Variables are escaped in HTML context; fill in at least one of HTML or plain text body
form.textBodyHint: Variables are replaced as-is in plain text context
form.bodyRequired: Fill in at least one of the HTML body and the plain text body
form.varsListHint: Comma/newline separated; leave empty to auto-extract from content on save, or provide an explicit list (may include variables not yet used)

vars.emptyHint: No placeholders yet; use {{sample}} in the subject or body to reference variables.
vars.chipTitle: Provide this variable via variables when sending

preview.title: Preview · {{name}}
preview.sampleVarsHint: Provided via the variables field when sending; placeholders without a value render empty

delete.title: Delete Template
delete.confirmPrefix: Are you sure you want to delete template
delete.warning: Historical send logs referencing this template keep the template ID for traceability; requests currently sending are unaffected.
